purpose: Prospective evaluation policy for a future independently curated parser-v3-v2 locked evaluation set. This artifact is registered before any set exists and contains no set-derived fact. It is not an authorization to construct, seal, or evaluate a set.

ontology.collapse_prohibited_note: present_unextractable must never be mapped to no_answer, ambiguous, or present. It may be retained only in a separate research-only corpus that is never scored by the frozen instrument.

support_derivation.method: counted from the registered presence of each stratum in evaluator_sets/parser_v3_v1/strata_definitions.md, at the registered 10 cases per stratum
support_derivation.independence_note: These values are derived from the public stratum definitions and equal the parser-v2 supports only because both sets use the same registered 12-stratum design. They were not copied from the parser-v2 gate contract and were not derived from any parser-v3 prediction.

gates.justification: S06 exists only to test that the parser does not select the trailing distractor. A single failure is the failure mode the stratum was built to detect, so zero tolerance follows from the stratum's purpose rather than from calibration.
S11 exists only to test that genuine multi-candidate ambiguity is reported as ambiguous rather than resolved arbitrarily.
S10 exists only to test that an unrecoverable malformed output yields no_answer.
S07 exists only to test that truncation before the final answer yields no_answer.
S08 exists only to test that an explicit refusal yields no_answer.
The clean strata carry unambiguous single answers in registered surface forms. Any error there is a defect in the parser, not a hard case.
Every declared class must be exercised. A zero denominator is an error, never NA.
Every declared class must be exercised. A zero denominator is an error, never NA.
Every declared class must be exercised. A zero denominator is an error, never NA.
No answer-bearing case may be scored by collapsing an unextracted answer into no_answer. This is the invariant the parser-v3-v1 set violated by admitting a fourth class.

acceptance_thresholds.reason: No calibration basis exists for a numeric acceptance threshold on parser v3. Phase 1.0C headroom calibration has not been run, and choosing a threshold from parser-v2 results or from any parser-v3 observation would either import an unjustified constant or select a threshold against the very measurement it is meant to bound.

items.note: Minimum number of the 120 cases whose typed decision must match exactly.
Per-stratum floor across the eight critical strata.
Macro F1 over the three answer-presence classes.
Comparator margin. Requires a registered comparator run on the same set, which does not exist.

acceptance_thresholds.prohibition: A threshold must never be adjusted to make a set or a parser acceptable. The contract compiler refuses to emit a contract while any threshold is REVIEW_REQUIRED.

comparators.requirement: Every comparator must be run on the identical locked inputs under the identical ontology and the identical span convention before any margin is computed.

status_logic.PASS: every mandatory gate satisfied AND every acceptance threshold satisfied
status_logic.FAIL: any mandatory gate violated OR any acceptance threshold missed
status_logic.INVALID: any artifact-agreement finding present, any gate denominator below its registered minimum, or any typed decision outside the three formal classes
status_logic.vacuity_rule: A mandatory gate with a zero denominator is an error. It is never reported as NA, never skipped, and never counted as satisfied.
